8.heading: For the head:
refs: Dr. Jubb transposes the former part of Isa 7:9 , and renders, "Though the head of Syria be Damascus
and the head of Damascus Retzin
and the head of Ephraim be Samaria
and the head of Samaria Remaliah's son
yet within threescore and five years Ephraim shall be broken, that he be no more a people." This renders the passage perfectly clear
and the prophecy received its full accomplishment when Esarhaddon carried away the remains of the ten tribes. 2Sa 8:6
that it be not a people:
